name: Eldritch Warden
body:
Your arcane abilities are devoted to protecting nature.

Prerequisite(s): Ability to cast arcane spells, elf.

Benefit(s): You add all summon nature’s ally spells to your arcane spell list. Your arcane spellcasting qualifies in place of divine casting for the nature warden prestige class, and you may increase spellcasting in your arcane class as you progress in nature warden levels. If you have the Attuned to the Wild and Mage of the Wild feats, those count as the favored terrain ability for all prerequisites.
